root_architecture_decision.stage1: 93-DOF toy Mode-I pure LEFM finite front perturbation diagnostic under frozen old-tip traction
root_architecture_decision.stage1_gauge_target: g=0 for both independently re-equilibrated geometries
root_architecture_decision.stage1_crack_faces: traction-free; no CZM assembly, no material Gc, no commit
root_architecture_decision.stage2: future real damage growth uses cohesive-history dissipation; do not add Gc*delta_area for the same damage

frozen_physical_boundary.source_traction_array: pure_I_boundary_traction_Pa from the accepted mixed93 cache, generated at the old tip with KI=100 Pa*sqrt(m)
frozen_physical_boundary.classification: synthetic old-tip benchmark traction; not a calibrated artifact load
policy: same physical xyz/normals/area weights/traction samples for old and candidate
reintegrate basis-dependent generalized f separately in each geometry
do not compare f_old and f_candidate as if they were the same coefficient vector
do not recalculate traction from the candidate solution or retune KI
do not project, repair, or drop vector traction components

volume.rule: GL4 radial parameter x GL32 theta x GL4 z, from frozen a0/theta32 cloud
volume.region: full cylinder volume, not a radial hole

mechanical_boundary.source: same frozen pure_I old-tip boundary cloud

quadrature_and_requery_budget.zero_query_precondition: all cache, source, MLS configuration, row IDs, xyz, weights, normals, and source hashes exactly match
quadrature_and_requery_budget.candidate_rule: same physical integration xyz/weights as parent; recompute shifted branch values/gradients analytically on all rows
quadrature_and_requery_budget.cache_mismatch_policy: block; any new query/requadrature requires a separately reviewed budget

basis_and_solve_contract.layout: 81 BASE + 12 GLOBAL_FRONT (four branch functions x three components)
basis_and_solve_contract.candidate_basis: same base MLS support rows; shift front origin to x=0.0005m and rebuild all GLOBAL_FRONT branch values/gradients
basis_and_solve_contract.assemblies: one bulk K and one basis-dependent external f per geometry

gauge.functional: same physical volume-average translations and rotations about same center/scale in each geometry
gauge.coefficient_matrix: re-express/reassemble in each geometry's basis; do not reuse manufactured nonzero-g cache

per_state: W=f_basis^T*q and verify as boundary integral of displacement against frozen physical traction
diagnostic_only_energy.reported_difference: delta_Pi and optionally -delta_Pi/(L*delta_a) labelled finite-potential diagnostic only

future_damage_growth.double_count_policy: do not add Griffith Gc*delta_area for the same cohesive fracture dissipation

performed: preserved old design and plan snapshots
